[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]
== Biography ==
Katherine Campbell, also called Katie Campbell, was recorded at Corsankell in Stevenston parish, Ayrshire, in the sixteenth century. The printed Cunninghame teind list names Katherine Campbell with the elder and younger James Glasgow.<ref>[https://aanhs.org/wp-content/uploads/2018/05/people-of-ayrshire.pdf Margaret H. B. Sanderson, The People of Sixteenth Century Ayrshire (1987), appendix The Cunninghame Teind Lists of 1559–60, p.331]. Printed list already held; no new page inspection in this review.</ref>

Morag Cross identifies Katie as the wife of [[Glasgow-1168|James Glasgow elder]], sharing his holding, and describes [[Glasgow-3921|James Glasgow younger]] as their son, citing Ayrshire Archives TD77/135, folio 6r.<ref>[https://www.euppublishing.com/doi/full/10.3366/saj.2014.0056 Atkinson, Brown, Cross, Taylor and Franklin, A late medieval farmstead at Corsankell, Scottish Archaeological Journal 36–37 (2014–15), 197–215, Historical Evidence section by Morag Cross], published online 21 August 2015. Full historical section inspected; underlying manuscript uninspected.</ref>

Her birth and death dates are not recorded. A birth before about 1544 is a conservative estimate assuming she was at least fifteen when listed in 1559–60; she was alive in the accounts dated 1561–1563. Stevenston is family residence evidence, not a proved birthplace or place of death.

== Research Notes ==
The wife identification is strongly supported at 93%. Her maternity of James younger is a probable 86% interpretation of the historian’s account, not a newly inspected manuscript parent clause. A stepmother remains possible. John Glasgow’s mother is not selected by association. The differently named Christian Campbell in the 1571 deed is not identified as Katherine.

No compatible Katherine, Katie or Catherine Campbell was found in the maintained public catalogue or the targeted WikiTree web searches. Six locally catalogued Campbell women have nineteenth-century births. Margaret Campbell (Campbell-73041) is a differently named wife of Christian Cunningham, with no documented Katie/James identity; her broad before-1623 birth alone is not an exclusion. This documentary account does not merge her or any other Campbell. The draft remains on source-verification hold pending the original teind wording; no live profile creation is proposed by this review.
